_about: Every input the price engine uses that is not in catalog.json. 'basis' says where the number comes from. BLUEPRINT = docs/blueprint-v1.0.md (itself an illustrative scenario, not quotes). RESEARCH = research notes from 2026-11-01. ASSUMPTION = my estimate, no source; replace with real quotes or invoices.

parts_mode_by_qty.basis: ASSUMPTION: where in the blueprint's planning range a part lands; one-off buys sit near the top, volume near the bottom

material_rate_per_g.basis: BLUEPRINT §8.3 illustrative PETG rate 1.90/g; spread is ASSUMPTION

setup_support_removal.basis: BLUEPRINT §8.3 illustrative 130 per job; spread is ASSUMPTION

print_fail_prob.basis: ASSUMPTION; blueprint Experiment A targets >=9/10 first-try prints

bureau_fdm_rate_per_cm3.basis: RESEARCH: IamRapid published FDM PLA 3-5 per cm3 (india_landscape.md line 75) - used only as a cross-check

minutes_per_op.basis: ASSUMPTION: my estimate of a trained assembler with a jig; blueprint Experiment B exists to measure this

loaded_labour_rate_per_h.basis: ASSUMPTION: Indian technician wage plus overhead, space and tools

first_article_factor_qty1.basis: ASSUMPTION: a never-built design takes about twice as long the first time

rework_prob.basis: ASSUMPTION; blueprint pilot ambition is first-build yield >85% (§12)

new_design_setup_nre.basis: BLUEPRINT §8.7 sensitivity example: one-time 3,000 engineering/setup fee

box_cm.basis: ASSUMPTION: outer box around the 108 x 78 x 124 mm robot plus padding and adapter

volumetric_divisor.basis: ASSUMPTION: common courier rule (L x W x H cm / 5000); blueprint §8.5 says it is courier specific

courier_rate_per_0p5kg_slab.basis: ASSUMPTION; a binding quote must call the Shiprocket serviceability API (blueprint §8.5)

returns_defect_only.basis: ASSUMPTION: returns accepted for defects only

returns_novelty.basis: RESEARCH: BubblePal (kids AI toy) return rate peaked above 30% and fell to about 20% (modular_devices_and_lessons.md line 149)

return_salvage_fraction_of_parts.basis: ASSUMPTION: electronics reused, personalised shell scrapped

payment_fee_rate.basis: ASSUMPTION: typical Indian gateway rate; GST on the fee is added in the engine

gst_rate.basis: ASSUMPTION: blueprint §8.7 warns 'do not apply 18% blindly'; HSN classification needs a tax adviser

binding_floor_margin_at_p95.basis: ASSUMPTION: the 'permitted contribution-loss threshold' of blueprint §8.8

A_live_voice.basis: ASSUMPTION: ~12 min/night of speech-to-text + LLM + speech; pin with real Vertex billing

B_story_generation.basis: ASSUMPTION: 30 stories/month, text + speech generated once each; pin with real Vertex billing
